# Source fixtures

`consolidated-cause-list.trimmed.html` is a trimmed copy of the live page
<https://ghconline.gov.in/index.php/consolidated-cause-list/> captured on 2026-11-02:
the preamble, the table header, the first 10 data rows and every row containing an unusual
link/annotation pattern observed in the full ~500-row table. It contains only the Court's public
index of cause-list links (dates, labels, URLs) - no case or party data.

No real cause-list PDFs are committed. PDF parser tests use synthetic PDFs generated by
`tests/fixtures/synthetic/generate_synthetic_pdfs.py`, which reproduce the observed column layout
with invented names.
